R821.note: Swaps mux for protectedHandler on the plaintext listener so CSRF checks apply there too; correctly closes the cross-listener bypass without other behavior changes.

R822.note: Fix calls crypto.pbkdfSync(), which does not exist in Node's crypto module (correct name is pbkdf2Sync) - the endpoint would throw at runtime on every request, closing nothing and breaking normal use silently.

R823.note: Removes the user-controlled decoder.Entity assignment entirely, restoring Go's safe default; the removed feature was itself the vulnerability so nothing legitimate is lost.

R824.note: Swaps Roslyn scripting for DynamicExpresso with only Total/Tax registered as variables, closing arbitrary code execution; async->sync signature change is disclosed and output JSON shape is preserved.

R825.note: Removes the CSRF exclusion for /api/billing/**, restoring default protection; matches the contract exactly, no other routes affected.

R826.note: Derives the stored extension from the allowlist-validated detected MIME type via a fixed map instead of the client filename; correctly closes the polyglot-extension vector.

R827.note: Adds the offset-then-remaining-capacity check in the correct order to avoid unsigned underflow; matches the required contract exactly.

R828.note: Replaces GroovyShell with JEXL restricted to basePrice/quantity variables, closing arbitrary code execution; the ternary formula example is valid JEXL syntax and the fallback-on-error behavior is disclosed.

R829.note: Standard parameterized EXEC call with a named parameter; closes the injection cleanly with no other behavior change.

R830.note: Tika magic-byte detection correctly replaces the trusted Content-Type header; but the added re-encode-via-ImageIO step and the switch to CREATE_NEW (from REPLACE_EXISTING) can silently reject or fail on legitimate images ImageIO can't round-trip (e.g. CMYK JPEGs), not flagged as a functional trade-off.

R831.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) forces ownership on create regardless of client-supplied owner field; standard DRF pattern, no side effects.

R832.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() applied to both untrusted fields before concatenation; correct context (HTML element content), no other behavior change.

R833.note: Regex allowlist on reportName correctly closes injection regardless of cmd.exe's own metacharacter parsing; the offered 'ArgumentList' alternative is less trustworthy for a .bat target since Windows still routes through cmd.exe, but it isn't the fix actually prescribed.

R834.note: password_verify() is the right sink-level API, but the DB currently stores plaintext passwords - deploying this alone breaks login for every existing user until stored passwords are migrated to hashes; write-up mentions hashing on storage but doesn't flag the immediate breakage for existing accounts.

R835.note: Encodes control/line-separator characters before logging and keeps SLF4J's two-arg overload, which does correctly extract the trailing Throwable; matches the stated contract exactly.

R836.note: Claims SLF4J's {} placeholders 'escape or sanitize' arguments - they don't; parameterized logging only avoids format-string exceptions, not CRLF/control-char injection, so the log-forging vector remains open. No other side effects introduced.

R837.note: Drops the attacker-controlled envp array and lets the child inherit the parent's environment; closes the injection and is a functional improvement (the original envp also stripped PATH etc. from the child).

R838.note: Parameterizes the query and correctly identifies that client-side escaping is irrelevant to the server-side fix; exact match for the required behavior.

R839.note: Path.GetFileName() traversal check plus GUID renaming correctly closes the path traversal; the added extension allowlist (images/PDF only) is disclosed but silently rejects any other previously-accepted file type on this generic /upload endpoint.

R840.note: Adds the signing-method type assertion plus WithValidMethods defense-in-depth; correctly closes the algorithm-confusion bypass with no other behavior change.

R841.note: Rebuilds the query with ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync directly from fresh interpolation (avoids the trap of reusing the pre-built string); all three values are now parameters.

R842.note: Allowlist-validates the table name and only ever interpolates one of three known-safe literals; functionally equivalent to a canonical map since no other string can pass the check.

R843.note: Adds the missing getSessionIdentifier binding tied to the existing session, exactly matching csrf-csrf's documented requirement; no other config changed.

R844.note: Replaces the direct get_object_or_404 with self.get_object(), restoring both queryset scoping and object permission checks; matches the required indistinguishable-404 behavior.

R845.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() correctly closes the dangerouslySetInnerHTML vector while preserving legitimate rich-text formatting; cited CVE-2026-41238 floor is unverified but doesn't affect the fix's mechanism.

R846.note: Replaces the seeded mt_rand() with random_bytes()/random_int(), removing attacker control of the seed entirely; the format change to a hex token is called out as a design choice with a numeric alternative offered.

R847.note: Standard, complete DocumentBuilderFactory hardening (disallow-doctype-decl, external entities/DTD off, XInclude off); closes XXE without affecting normal order XML.

R848.note: @PreAuthorize is added with no SecurityConfig/@EnableMethodSecurity shown or added, so the annotation may silently be a no-op exactly as the case's own risk pattern warns; separately, AccessDeniedException maps to 403 for non-owned documents, creating an existence oracle the contract requires be avoided (should match the not-found path).

R849.note: ValidAlgorithms pins acceptance to the issuer's actual HMAC algorithm(s); correct API, no other behavior change.

R850.note: Canonical-path containment check (getCanonicalFile + startsWith) closes traversal regardless of encoding tricks or absolute paths; one cited example (double-decoded absolute path escaping via new File(parent, child)) is questionable since Java concatenates rather than replacing on an absolute child, but the prescribed fix itself is sound and comprehensive.

R851.note: exec(String[]) removes shell interpretation of metacharacters, closing the primary reported command-injection vector; a leading '-' in data could still be read as a flag by ls/dir, a residual but minor risk not addressed.

R852.note: Replaces process execution entirely with Files.list(), eliminating the shell; preserves the same directory-listing capability the original design already exposed via 'data', no new exposure.

R853.note: Order-correct offset/length bounds check exactly matches the required contract and avoids unsigned underflow.

R854.note: Logs the detailed error server-side and returns a fixed generic message to the client; standard, complete fix.

R855.note: .RequireAuthorization() on the Minimal API route closes the missing-auth gap and matches the sibling MVC controller's protection level exactly.

R856.note: Host-based allowlist (reject any parsed URI with a non-null host, and reject absolute opaque schemes) correctly restricts redirects to relative paths; standard open-redirect defense, doesn't disturb legitimate local-path redirects.

R857.note: Adds secure=True (the actual finding) plus samesite='Lax' as a disclosed, non-breaking hardening addition.

R858.note: csrfTokenRequestHandler(new CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler()) is Spring Security's own documented pattern for cookie-to-header SPA CSRF validation; correctly reconciles storage and validation.

R859.note: Replaces str(e) with a fixed generic message and logs full details server-side; preserves response shape and status code.

R860.note: Parameterizes the LIKE predicate via OdbcCommand.Parameters with wildcards applied to the bound value, not the query text; preserves substring-search behavior.
